title: Father's ship crew sees an object leave the water
place_text: at sea; jungles and ocean (father from Honduras)

plain: An entire ship's crew of 29 or 30 men once watched something come up out of the ocean, rise into the sky and shoot away. Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site, says his father, who is from Honduras and claims to have seen many strange things in the jungle and at sea, used to tell him this story often. It is told as one more account of objects that move between water and air.
